scope: Current actual two originals only; not a new positive/negative classifier
limitations: WordBoundary and donor ASR only locate candidates; neither proves realization.
Adjacent bi/yi may coalesce; two F0 islands are not a count of pronounced syllables.
DTW may stretch a vowel, so closeness alone cannot disprove deletion; actual unwarped vowel sequence must be inspected.
No deletion-negative control was created or assumed. No human listening claim.
